cases.prompt: Зафиксируй всё, что мы согласовали выше: точные тексты экрана, порядок шагов и права менеджера.

Из трёх обсуждавшихся вариантов принят второй; зафиксируй результат без хроники обсуждения.
Зафиксируй требование по этому скриншоту и ссылке на референс, сохрани обязательные свойства.

Новое решение меняет Outcome; убедись, что Acceptance evidence больше не требует старого поведения.
Apply the Requirement authoring standard before you record this change as a Business Requirement.
Rename this helper function to match the naming convention across its call sites.
Fix the off-by-one in this pagination offset; the cause is already established.
Run the focused unit tests for the parser module.
Review this authentication change for security issues.
Write the design.md and delta specs for this existing managed task.
Implement the already specified endpoint exactly as described in the managed task.
Create a technical managed task for the lifecycle script fix as requested.
Let us compare two designs for the cache; do not record anything yet.

Format this module with the repository formatter.

quality_comparisons.objective_verifier: The capability test asserts the standard requires material accepted detail (texts, order, rights, constraints, references) to be carried over without loss and forbids replacing an exact decision with a generic quality phrase.

The capability test asserts that only explicit acceptance supersedes, that negotiation history is dropped except an active boundary, and that a changed decision rewrites Outcome, scenarios, Exclusions and Acceptance evidence together.
The capability test asserts the three binding levels, preserved reachable references, explicit unavailable-attachment handling and the ban on substituting a mutable site root.

The capability test asserts questions only for unresolved material choices (one to three grouped), no mandatory interview, and no new gate, status, validator, ledger, storage or per-project setting; the fixture's ten hard-negative prompts never trigger the standard.
